Commission & profitability

Get new customers and increase profits at zero cost

A kiosk in your shop brings footfall and a steady monthly commission – with no installation cost and no extra staff.

Profitability & efficiency

  1. You need just half a square metre to install the terminal.
  2. Self-service kiosks work 24/7 with no staff effort involved.
  3. Kiosks work autonomously and are controlled remotely.
  4. Transactions are verified automatically.

Partnership with RaspberryPay helps retailers and store owners attract new customers and increase profits. Owners of commercial premises get potential buyers as well as a net income from the sales commission for the kiosk space.

Installation of the kiosks does not imply any cost to the retailer. Our self-service payment kiosks are fully automated, available to your clients 24/7 and don't require any assistance from your employees.
